title: Resource graph of an AWS account (the twin's, then real ones)
description: Shape of twin-graph*.json. Draft by ontology.aws.a@SovereignWebsite.dinis, 23 Nov 2026, for architect.aws.c and the UIs to challenge. Terms: 2026-11-23__01-resource-ontology.md. build-twin-graph.mjs checks every graph it writes against the enums, required fields and references here, and also that every edge end is a node, ids are unique and counts add up (rules JSON Schema cannot state).

evidence.description: How we know a link, strongest first: an AWS API answered it; a CloudFormation template declares it; read from inside a file or record; inferred from a name; only a code comment says so; asserted by the ontologist.

altitude.description: Memo section 21: A0 atoms, A1 cells (events, objects), A2 molecules (resources), A3 organs (systems), A4 people (actors, roles), A5 civilisation (business functions).

relation.description: Each reads forward and backward in plain English; see the ontology doc, sections 3, 9, 10 and 11.

id.description: The ARN where AWS defines one, otherwise a stable derived URN, urn:sws:<kind>:<name>, the same for the twin and a real account.

inferred.description: No API in the data source describes this node; it is known only through other evidence.

dangling.description: Named somewhere but not found where it should exist; see note.

source.description: Which call, file or rule the link comes from, so a user can check it.
